bio: Aafiya Irfan Ahmed Shaikh is an undergraduate student of English Language and Literature with a strong interest in journalism, research and content writing.
Her interests include language, education and social issues, and she values critical thinking, evidence-based analysis and storytelling that informs and engages readers.
